analyst.summary: JSW Infrastructure is a well-run, growing port-and-logistics operator (FY26 revenue +20%, adjusted PAT +12%) that just raised Rs 7,503 crore to fund an ambitious capacity expansion from 183 to 400 MTPA by FY30 and to chase port-privatization deals. The balance sheet is solid (D/E 0.63x, GREEN flags) and third-party cargo now diversifies the business away from pure captive-JSW-Group dependence. But the stock trades at a rich ~47x earnings, the most recent quarter's actual cargo volume grew only 1% YoY, and reported profit fell 18% YoY on one-off forex/fire-related losses -- so the multiple is pricing in flawless multi-year execution of a very large capex plan funded partly by fresh dilution. Hold: a quality growth story, but not cheap enough here to add, and not broken enough to sell.
